record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.kind: on-simulation-start effect; the Tatsugiri is removed and turned into an item on an adjacent same-team Dondozo
record.summary: Passive.COMMANDER has one PassiveEffects entry, commanderPassive, an OnSimulationStartEffect applied when the fight starts. It looks at the up-to-eight cells around the Tatsugiri (diagonals included) for the first cell holding a unit named DONDOZO on the same team with fewer than 3 items. If one exists, the Tatsugiri entity is deleted from its team, its cell is emptied, its DPS-meter entry is dropped, and the Dondozo entity receives a form-specific item through addItem (not permanent): TATSUGIRI_CURLY -> Item.TATSUGIRI_CURLY (declared ATK +8), TATSUGIRI_DROOPY -> Item.TATSUGIRI_DROOPY (declared DEF +8), TATSUGIRI_STRETCHY -> Item.TATSUGIRI_STRETCHY (declared SPEED +25). If no such Dondozo is adjacent, nothing happens and the Tatsugiri stays and fights. These amounts are the requested (declared) values; applyItemEffect routes them through addAttack/addDefense/addSpeed with caster = the Dondozo itself and AP boost 0, so a Big Eater Belt on the Dondozo multiplies the positive amount by 1.25 rounded down (8 -> 10 ATK, 8 -> 10 DEF, 25 -> 31 SPEED) and the applied change is also subject to the ATK floor of 1, DEF floor of 0 and the speed clamp. The ORDER_UP ability and the RICE dish separately read a Tatsugiri on the player's board; they are not part of this passive.
triggers: Simulation start, once per Tatsugiri entity (OnSimulationStartEffect)

effects.declaredRaw: Tatsugiri entity removed from the fight; Dondozo gains the form's item
effects.scaling: none (no AP, no crit; apBoost 0, crit false)
effects.resolution: requested: ATK +8 / DEF +8 / SPEED +25 by form; applied: through addAttack (rounded, Big Eater Belt, Twist Band, floor 1), addDefense (floor 0) or addSpeed (helpers then clamp 0..MAX_SPEED) on the Dondozo entity; the item is added to entity.items only (permanent false) so it does not persist on the board Pokémon

effects.declaredRaw: adjacent same-team DONDOZO with fewer than 3 items
effects.resolution: first matching cell in getAdjacentCells order (rows top to bottom, columns left to right, centre excluded); addItem also refuses at 3 items

effects.declaredRaw: applied once when the simulation starts
effects.resolution: Simulation iterates each team's entities and applies OnSimulationStart effects in team order; because entities are processed one after another, a second Tatsugiri next to the same Dondozo sees the item count already raised by the first

conditions: Only a unit named exactly DONDOZO on the same team counts; a Dondozo already holding 3 items is skipped (search continues to other adjacent cells).
Without a matching adjacent Dondozo the Tatsugiri is untouched.
Two or more Tatsugiri can feed the same Dondozo until it has 3 items, checked in the order the team's entities are processed.
If Dondozo already holds the same Tatsugiri item, addItem does not add it again (items is a set) but the Tatsugiri is still removed.
Tatsugiri cannot hold items (canHoldItems false in the class).
record.resetBehaviour: No stored state. Each fight starts from the board again; the item lives only on the fight entity (addItem is called with permanent false).
